notes: The PDF holds two copies of the paper: pages 0-35 are the clean paper (Section I answer sheet last), pages 36-71 are a teacher-marked copy with handwritten worked answers in red and a filled Section I answer sheet. Questions were parsed from the clean copy; the handwritten answers are extracted as solutions and the MCQ key (circled options and the filled answer sheet agree). Handwritten working was transcribed as written and has not been checked; Q24 (100 480) and Q32(iii) (written as -1<r<1) look questionable. Section II questions printed 16-43 with parts i), ii) directly under the number. Printed typos: Q1 options are labelled 'C) 6' and 'C) 8' (second C fixed to D in the stored options); Q7 'What it the time' (should be 'is'); Q27 'correct the nearest square centimetre' (cubic centimetre intended, and 'to' missing); Q38 'represent The maximum number' (sentence run-on); Q43 'express in terms of P and V' is missing a word (probably k). Q28 prints '1- cm grid'. Questions 38(ii) cut and Q36 diagram ink in the marked copy were not cropped as solution figures (answers are numeric/bearings given as text). Section I 15 marks, Section II 85 marks (28 questions); marks per part read from margins and sum to 85.
